description: Eval for the bug-repro skill. See ../references/eval-playbook.md for the 4 mandatory design rules.

input.user_prompt: On commit abc123, parse_config returns None when the file has a trailing newline, but parse_config is expected to return an empty dict.

rubric.criterion: Test code is present and runnable
Test asserts the expected behavior (empty dict, not None)
Failure output from running the test is included
Agent does NOT produce a confident test for an unspecified bug
Agent asks for the missing details (which scenario, which version, which path)

input.user_prompt: Sentry alert: TypeError: Cannot read property 'id' of undefined at UserService.getById (src/services/user.js:42:18) triggered 312 times in the last hour

rubric.criterion: Test reproduces the TypeError on the reported line
Test sets up the precondition (undefined user object)
Test uses jest, not a different framework
